records.title: Vehicle pose layers compose with the active world dictionary
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3; locally supplied stock and reconstructed-world animation dictionaries, 2026-10-11
records.observation: An installed full-dictionary pose override was bypassed by alternate-world selection. A validated eleven-clip layer now composes after world selection; 236 slots and 225 unrelated animations are retained, with identical native samples for unaffected clips.
records.limitations: Production loader/compression/interpolation and activation fixtures passed; rendered seating, contacts and transitions were not tested. Game-derived inputs and private runtime implementation are withheld.

records.title: Passenger pose selection must follow occupant role
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64, version 0.2.134, 2026-10-11
records.observation: A script-created opening passenger, native spawned passengers and directly warped passengers selected driver clips despite successful layer activation. Corrected role selection passed fifteen actual-engine normal/low-car seat cases. Three rendered views with the layer disabled/enabled confirmed the passenger clip and retained driver recline without changing imported motion data.
records.limitations: Rendered opening-scene poses and native seat-role selection were checked; perfect wheel/seat contacts, all meshes and entry/exit transitions remain outside coverage. Game-derived inputs, captures, private receipts and runtime implementation are withheld from Workshop.

records.title: Driver translation checks do not establish physical seat fit
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64, existing 0.2.134 host, 2026-10-11
records.observation: Rendered opening-scene review showed the driver too low and too far back despite correct clip selection. A height-only candidate left backward placement unresolved. The revised local import changes only waist Y/Z in nine driver clips, moving them 6/128 m forward and 5/128 m upward while retaining reclined rotations; both passenger clips and 225 unrelated clips are byte-identical. Three actual-engine comparisons passed fifteen role cases each, with three matching views per run; vehicle-local bone measurements confirmed both driver shifts and unchanged passenger placement.
records.limitations: Subsequent owner review and bounded seat-surface measurements rejected the translation as a complete seating fix. These checks establish the applied driver offset and unchanged passenger placement; physical fit, contacts, all vehicle/character combinations and transitions remain unaccepted. Game-derived inputs, captures, runtime implementation and private receipts are withheld.

records.title: Coupled pose refitting needs both-role rear-panel and roof checks
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64, existing 0.2.134 host, 2026-10-11
records.observation: A local import now uses separate normal/low profiles for both occupant roles, coupled pelvis/spine rotations and rotation-only driver arm IK without stretching bones. The initial candidate cleared rear panels but failed low-car left-action roof clearance; it was corrected before installation. The revised candidate passed fifteen native role cases, twenty-one action clip/weight checks and thirty-three rendered base/action views in three car meshes. Forty-eight occupant/base/action geometry cases showed no reviewed rear-surface protrusion/crossing or head protrusion above the upper roof envelope. Twenty-three synthetic checks passed and 225 unrelated animation slots remained unchanged. The change was merged before local regeneration and installation; no production executable update is required.
records.limitations: Acceptance covers the observed exterior protrusion in sampled base, steering, reverse, drive-by and half-blend poses. Front upholstery/cushion intersections remain; a missing lower rear panel remains missing coverage. Every action frame, character, vehicle, wheel-rim contact and entry/exit transition is outside acceptance. Use reviewed roof geometry rather than an arbitrary overlapping body plane. Native implementation, original/derived game geometry, motion, captures, plots and private receipts are withheld.

records.title: Static vehicle props need authored world material modulation
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64 D3D9, 0.2.135, 2026-10-12
records.observation: The opening bridge wrecks used static world geometry, with original model bytes and decoded texture colours matching a locally supplied reference. Neo world rendering forced material RGB to white. Geometry-aware material modulation restored grey and teal paint in captured gameplay. Vehicle palette changes target the wrong path.
records.limitations: Windows D3D9 sampled opening props only; OpenGL integration was checked at source level. Game-derived inputs, captures and runtime code remain withheld.

records.title: Repeated new games expose stale vehicle reflection ownership
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64 D3D9, 0.2.134 baseline and 0.2.135 repair, 2026-10-12
records.observation: The baseline reproduced heap corruption during the second restart, detected in vehicle MatFX texture/raster destruction using matching native symbols. Source review found vehicle model loading before reflection resource loading and released globals retained across games. Loading reflection resources before models and clearing released pointers passed six opening sequences, five actual restart cycles, twelve renderer on/off captures and clean exit.
records.limitations: A free-time stack locates detection, not necessarily the original invalid access. Small dumps can omit heap objects. This test covers sampled New Game cycles, not every mission, renderer, GPU or save/load path. Private dumps, symbols, addresses, captures and native implementation are withheld.

records.title: Radio-off states need recognizable artwork at the rendered size
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64 D3D9, 0.2.136, 2026-10-12
records.observation: A detailed crossed-out radio was replaced with an authored 32-pixel, two-colour RADIO OFF wordmark. One input supplies packed texture and native fallback. Seventeen native HUD stages at each of 1280x720 and 640x480 covered all nine stations, off state, wanted levels 0-6 and HUD restart. Captured off-state pixels, centering and clearance passed, with manual review beside all station logos.
records.limitations: Enlarged previews and pixel-difference metrics cannot establish meaning or stylistic fit. Coverage is limited to sampled English HUD presentation on Windows D3D9. Game-derived logos, captures and private runtime implementation are withheld.

records.title: A legible HUD icon still needs artwork and effective sampling that fit its neighbours
records.target: GTA III / re3 Extended f8142f1 source-integrated Windows x64 D3D9, candidate 0.2.142, 2026-10-12
records.observation: A two-colour square wordmark was legible but visually too rigid and saturated. Authored 32-pixel slanted lettering, muted shading and soft alpha edges were compared beside all nine native station icons at 1280x720 and 640x480. Seventeen HUD stages at each resolution passed off/station rendering, wanted levels 0-6, clearance and HUD restart. Captured letter interiors matched authored pixels with mean RGB channel error below 0.01 on the 0-255 scale. The sprite path binds a raster without applying texture filter metadata; instrumentation confirmed identical effective nearest sampling for stations and off. Packed/native fallback art remains byte-identical. The rendering tool executed on original authored images under declared matched offline conditions.
records.limitations: Pixel differences, texture dimensions and filter metadata alone cannot establish visual fit. Manual review and native checks cover the sampled Windows D3D9 English HUD sizes, not every renderer or subjective preference. This is authored styling, not historical asset recovery. Public tools do not perform the native checks; private instrumentation, game-derived station art/captures, runtime implementation and personal configuration are withheld.

records.title: Explicit wanted selections need a chase-local story-cap override
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64 D3D9, trainer candidate 0.2.140, 2026-10-12
records.observation: Early campaign limits prevented 5/6-star selections. Forty-nine requested-star/story-cap combinations passed ten native wanted updates each, FBI/army response checks, clear-to-natural-cap restoration and Never wanted conflict handling. Actual trainer button clicks applied 5, 6 and Clear. Both global story limits remain unchanged; the explicit override belongs to the current player/chase.
records.limitations: These checks establish sampled star selection and native response flags, not an entire chase, all mission transitions or every scripted wanted manipulation. Private native implementation, instrumentation, game-derived captures, logs and personal settings are withheld.

records.title: Overlay controls require independent IDs and symmetric input forwarding
records.target: GTA III / source-integrated re3 Windows x64 D3D9, trainer candidate 0.2.140, 2026-10-12
records.observation: Quick tools and registered widgets shared an ImGui ID. Scoped IDs and removing duplicate controls avoid the conflict. Native input checks preserve held movement, mouse deltas and script restrictions; key down/up, raw motion and mouse messages reach the engine. Focus loss, Escape and closing during a drag release UI capture. Moving the overlay after the final HUD font pass prevents mission text drawing over controls. A 640x480 click test caught feedback pushing star controls beyond the clipping area; stable feedback space and tighter spacing resolved it. Final 1280x720 and 640x480 tests passed 289 and 276 hover-ID checks across eight pages and scroll positions, health/wanted searches and 60 frames each of live movement and mouse-camera rotation.
records.limitations: This records native message routing and sampled overlay behavior, not every device, DPI, controller layout or scripted restriction. Native click tests must wait for game-thread actions and inject test positions after backend polling. Capture differences alone cannot establish input correctness. Private runtime source, instrumentation and game-derived captures remain withheld.

records.title: Rejected script sounds must retain and release allocation ownership
records.target: GTA III / re3 Extended f8142f1 source-integrated Windows x64 D3D9 OpenAL, candidate 0.2.141, 2026-10-12
records.observation: Matching executable/PDB identities located a null allocation dereference in script-sound playback. A controlled native comparison retaining allocation guards but restoring the pinned sound submission body filled the object pool from 15 to 256 after rejected entity requests. Rejection cleanup kept usage at 15 after 5000 requests. Native runs at verified engine caps of 60 and 165 passed full object-pool recovery, unavailable audio, invalid events and 30 bursts of 1000 sounds. The 40-entry native queue rejected overflow without leaking objects/entities, and normal next-frame service reclaimed accepted objects.
records.limitations: The small dump omitted pool heap contents and does not prove which sound or previous leak filled that session's pool. Stress tests establish the reproduced failure mechanism, not every mission or all crashes. The diagnostics family supplied-address demo passed but does not decode minidumps/PDBs; exact-symbol inspection used private instrumentation. Private symbols, dumps, addresses, native implementation, fixtures and personal settings are withheld.
